status: Four confirmed input/editing defects fixed and validated; complete migration/release acceptance remains open

measuredPlatforms: Chromium desktop public UI with modeled file IPC
Actual macOS bundled WKWebView general smoke

productionChanges.issue: Pen release pressure0 shrank the stabilized tail of brush/eraser strokes.
productionChanges.before: Four paired mouse/pen trajectories (eight UI executions) differed at same-position and moved release; constant contact pressure1 pen left the endpoint unchanged while mouse painted/erased it.
productionChanges.fix: Only finishing pen samples with pressure0 reuse the last stroke pressure. Ordinary drawing pressure0 and pressure-off behavior remain.
productionChanges.policy: Same-position behavior agrees with observed Qt. Moved release deliberately applies consistent last-contact-pressure semantics; not an assertion of byte-exact equivalence to every Qt tablet path.

productionChanges.issue: Erasing an already transparent source zeroed hidden RGB and created unwanted history.
productionChanges.before: Raw [193,71,117,0] became [0,0,0,0], dirty and Undo changed.
productionChanges.fix: Before allocating a pixel tile, skip transparent erasing only when the pre-stroke alpha was0. Existing tiles use tile.before; matchColor explicit replacement is excluded.
contracts: Visible no-op preserves raw RGBA, saved state and Redo with zero pixel tiles
Hidden layer may still gain visibility-only metadata history and cancels exactly
Original alpha1 rounded to0 by partial coverage can still finish to raw zero at stronger coverage

productionChanges.issue: Pointer failure cleanup lost registration/selection ownership.
productionChanges.before: Injected coverage allocation failure plus real capture loss and outside release caused the next same-pointer gesture to be ignored. Real size-profile rejection after provisional selection resize left a changed raster, differing by4 RGBA bytes after Enter. Picker capture loss without drag also left stale registration.
productionChanges.fix: Pointer-owned errors use the existing cancelPointer resource boundary, then full redraw invalidation. cancelPointer unregisters before releasing capture; registered lost-capture owners are handled even without drag. keepPointers=true preserves both navigation owners.
contracts: Original stroke and selection geometry/raster restored
First retry accepted, original Undo/Redo preserved
Normal pointerup removes ownership before implicit capture release

productionChanges.issue: Spray interval exceptions escaped the input recovery boundary.
productionChanges.before: One injected Math.random failure produced a pageerror, then random calls continued from1 to65, capture and provisional pixels remained, and release committed47 nontransparent pixels.
productionChanges.fix: Timer work has a local try/catch routed to the same pointer-owned error boundary. Normal ticks keep their existing draw path.
contracts: Exactly one injected failure; timer stops and capture releases
Full Canvas and raw source restore, clean/Redo survive, late release ignored
Error status shown; real new spray and a single Undo succeed

previousGraphPreservation.scope: Preserves the exact graph referenced by the earlier immutable viewport report; the docs graph is a rolling current-state file.

graphLinkCorrection.scope: AST/source/asset/native verification fields are unchanged. Only historical viewport report links were corrected to fixed archives; no source or test changed.

reproduction.diagnosticCorrection: The pointer baseline firstSameAsOriginal JSON.stringify diagnostic is unsuitable for typed-array representation; its assert.deepEqual(first,original) and white Canvas prove the first retry was ignored. Neither diagnostic nor observation timeout was used to restart a live run.

engine.scope: Node engine regression; later main-only error-cleanup edits did not change the tested engine.

actualMacOS.scope: Actual bundled native UI, IPC and isolated filesystem recovery, plus isolated 4096²/32768×1 codec, native quit-ownership and final-scene rendering runs; macOS runs WKWebView. Does not exercise OS file picker dialogs, manual visual acceptance, physical Android or another host platform.

verification.ci: New test:eraser-picker-contract is wired into the existing web job; pointer contract remains wired. Remote CI was not run.
limits: Chromium CDP pen is not a physical stylus or Android device
Allocation and spray random failures are deliberate one-shot injections; repeated OOM or graphics context loss is not certified
Selection limit rejection used real public CDP events with a large finite coordinate; not a manual physical monitor gesture
Native four-process smoke protects general persistence/quit/codec/render compatibility; it does not certify physical pen behavior
No new performance benchmark; previous viewport/mip timing retains its own source/binary scope
